From the brand

From the manufacturer

WHY MILLIONS CHOOSE SKECHERS

Comfort That Moves With You 

Our signature designs are built with comfort in mind—delivering lasting support and cushion no matter where life takes you.

Innovation Across Every Style 

From hands-free wear to cushioned tech, Skechers brings comfort and innovation to a wide selection of shoes and apparel for every lifestyle.

Wide Variety for Every Style 

From sneakers to casual wear, Skechers offers a broad range of shoes and apparel for men, women, and kids—crafted for style and comfort.

Style & Comfort, No Extra Cost

Experience the best in quality, comfort, and versatility, all while enjoying the value Skechers brings across a variety of footwear and apparel.

  • Are Skechers just casual shoes, or do they offer styles for other needs too?

    Skechers offers everything from everyday sneakers and dress-casual styles to athletic, work, walking, and even performance footwear—plus apparel and accessories to match.

  • What makes Skechers shoes so comfortable?

    Skechers is known as the comfort technology company. Many of our styles include features like Air-Cooled Memory Foam, Arch Fit, and Luxe Foam for all-day support.

  • Does Skechers offer options for both men and women?

    Yes! Skechers designs shoes, clothing, and accessories for men, women, and kids—with inclusive sizing, styles, and fits for every lifestyle.

  • Are Skechers good for walking or being on your feet all day?

    Absolutely! Many Skechers styles are made with lightweight materials and cushioned insoles—perfect for long hours of standing or walking.

  • Are Skechers products affordable?

    Yes! Skechers offers premium comfort and style at an accessible price, delivering great value without compromising quality.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

Customers say

Customers love these sneakers for their comfort, with one noting they don't force the foot to the outside, and appreciate the excellent arch support that prevents foot aches. The shoes are extremely cushy and provide good value for money. Customers disagree on the fit, with some reporting they run large and wide while others find them too narrow. The slip-on feature and durability also receive mixed feedback, with some finding them easy to slip on and saying they should last a long time, while others report the heels slipping and the soles breaking apart.

    I have had a hard time finding shoes I can stand in all day, and though I do not struggle with foot pain, my hips and knees are arthritic. Most shoes to alleviate pain include wide widths (I have narrow feet) and correct pronation (I supinate). These have light to moderate arch support, which doesn't force my foot to the outside, and are roomy without being loose. I was able to slip them on without adjusting the laces. Though the ankle is too low to give support- the inserts are perfect for me. They control my stability in the right places- while still being cushiony and soft. I would not run or do anything high impact in these- but for walking and standing all day- they are efficient. Also- first pair of actually cute skechers I’ve ever owned.

    3 out of 5 stars
    Actual comfy shoes with support, but definitely not good on wet concrete :p
    Reviewed in the United States on March 23, 2026
    Size: 6.5 WideColor: Black
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    Initially ordered a size 6. I did an exchange for a 6.5Wide as it provides more wiggle room. I do not like very tight shoes. the 6 was way too tight for me. they are easy to slip on/off, the soles are thicker than what i prefer, but they are NOT platform style soles, so they should work fine, it is SUPPORT! (avid 25+ year Converse All Star wearer here). they seem to have excellent traction, i've only worn them out once (after i received my exchanged pair) and it was a comfy walk on dry sidewalk. the shoe quality seems to be good, i have noticed a few frayed threads sticking out, but honestly, i do not care. i dislike wearing shoes inside my home, especially on a top floor apartment (noise to neighbors, yes im nice and do everything to prevent heavy walking), but recently have an issue with tendonitis in one foot. OBVIOUSLY from my chucks and getting older and how i walk around at home lol, but listen, I wore these inside for a hour and hardly any noise, i felt floaty... normally I just slide around in socks. OVERALL: the wearability seems on point, I don't have any complaints yet. they are for work where I will be on concrete all day. I already know these will help. I can't really say HOW to choose your size, just do the research and buy a pair with the idea- you may have to exchange for a different size, and with that said- DO NOT LOSE THE TAGS (i removed mine from shoes but kept in great condition inside box for the return), DO NOT WALK OUTSIDE, KEEP EVERYTHING IN GOOD CONDITION- IN CASE- you have to do an exchange. They're worth the money, I honestly believe so and I don't like any shoe but converse all-stars. oh, and they send you an extra set of longer laces which i prefer. hope this helps anyone :)

    **Update- I wore these to work in a bakery/coffee/cafe, where there is concrete flooring. And by the dish area and after mopping it is too wet for these. These have 0 protection on slip-resistant. They aren't stated to have it, but who knows, some say there is good traction on wet sidewalks, so thats a plus. I can no longer wear them at work, did it for 1 day and can't risk it. The other downside for me, they have memory foam which traps heat, living in Texas, this is a huge nono. I'm learning so much about shoes in the last week I could be a sales person. If you're looking for slip-resistant, breathable. No. I did size up to a Wide which I thought would help, but these shoes are too tight for my preference. That said- they form to your foot, if you like that. They ARE comfortable, but just not what I'm looking for. I'm bummed because cute and cozy, but my work demands a different type of shoe.

About this Item

  • PODIATRIST-CERTIFIED SUPPORT: Featuring the Arch Fit insole system developed with 20 years of data and 120,000 foot scans for superior arch support and comfort
  • EASY SLIP ON DESIGN: These slip on shoes for women feature a convenient slip-on design with decorative laces for a classic sneaker look
  • CUSTOMIZED COMFORT: Removable insole molds to your foot shape, providing personalized comfort and enhanced shock absorption
  • LIGHTWEIGHT CUSHIONING: Canvas upper paired with a lightweight cushioned midsole delivers all-day comfort for these womens slip on shoes
  • VEGAN FRIENDLY DESIGN: Crafted with 100% vegan materials, these slip on sneakers for women combine style with ethical construction

Product Description

Experience superior comfort with these stylish Skechers slip on shoes for women. The Arch Fit Arcade Arcata features a canvas upper with decorative laces and podiatrist-certified arch support. Perfect for all-day wear, these womens slip on shoes combine fashion with function, offering a removable insole that molds to your foot and a lightweight cushioned midsole for enhanced comfort. These vegan-friendly slip on sneakers for women deliver both style and support for your daily activities.
